name: tcia_lidc_idri
title: TCIA LIDC-IDRI: 1 018 thoracic CTs for lung nodule analysis (DICOM)
description: The Lung Image Database Consortium collection: 1 018 CT scans of 1 010 patients with nodule annotations by four radiologists (the XML annotations are on the collection page; DICOM SEG and SR objects derived from them are in NBIA as separate series). This manifest exposes the CT series; patients with several CT series keep the first. Series are listed through the public NBIA API (no account) and each one is downloaded as a zip of DICOM files on first access; the folder is then a DICOM volume (LPS mm from the headers).

license.note: CC BY 3.0 on the TCIA collection page (checked 2026-10-14).
